item_short_desc: Rothco's Mini Pistol Belts are a compact and durable version of our classic military pistol belt. Crafted from high-quality polyester material, these belts maintain the strength and functionality of their larger counterparts, originally designed to support and carry pistols. Measuring 1 1/4" wide and adjustable up to 50" in length, the Mini Pistol Belt ensures a comfortable fit for waist sizes up to 46". Featuring a reliable metal clip closure, this belt provides secure wear and pairs seamlessly with BDU uniform pants or tactical gear.
